step1.title: Ƙirƙiri Asusun Mai Sarrafa
step1.subtitle: Wannan shine saitunan farko. Ƙirƙiri asusun mai sarrafa.

step2.title: Yadda BCookieSubs Ke Aiki
step2.subtitle: Taqaitaccen bayani kafin ka tsara tsarin.
step2.roleTranslationDesc: Matsayin asali. Samfurin yana karɓar layin taken ƙasa da aka karya zuwa ɓangarori kuma yana dawo da rubutun da aka fassara. Aƙalla samfuri ɗaya na Fassara yana buƙata. Lokacin da samfuran Fassara da yawa ke aiki, kowanne yana samar da fassarar ƴan takara, kuma Mai Shari'a yana zaɓar mafi kyau.
step2.roleJudgeDesc: BCookieSubs yana zuwa tare da bambance-bambancen umarni na fassara 5 ta tsoho. Kowane ɓangare ana fassara shi sau ɗaya a kowace umarni mai aiki, wanda ke samar da ƴan takarar da yawa. Mai Shari'a yana kimanta duk ƴan takarar kuma yana zaɓar mafi ingancin fassara. Ba tare da samfuri na Mai Shari'a ba, ana amfani da ƴan takara na farko kai tsaye.
step2.roleNameFormatterDesc: Yana gano fim ɗin ko shirin TV daga sunan fayil ko sunan fayil. Ana amfani da shi yayin lodawa taken ƙasa da kuma yayin binciken ɗakin karatu don a alamta fassarori tare da kafofin watsa labarai masu kyau. Yana buƙatar haɗin TheMovieDB da aka saita don mafi kyawun sakamako.
step2.promptsDesc: Kowane matsayi yana amfani da samfurin umarni da ake aika zuwa samfurin. Za a iya samun sigogin umarni da yawa. BCookieSubs yana bin sawun sigar da ta fi aiki don kowace haɗewar samfuri da yare kuma ta inganta ta ta atomatik.
step2.placeholdersLabel: Ana maye gurbin alamomin masu riƙo a cikin rubutun umarni a lokacin gudana:
step2.promptsEditHint: Za a iya gyara umarnai da faɗaɗa su akan shafin Umarnai a kowane lokaci.
step2.defaultChunkSizeDesc: Adadin layin taken ƙasa da ake aika zuwa samfurin a kowace buƙata. Ƙananan ɓangarori suna ba da mafi yawan mahallin ga kowane kira; manyan ɓangarori suna da sauri gaba ɗaya.
step2.finishOneFirst: Gama Taken Ƙasa Ɗaya Da Farko
step2.finishOneFirstDesc: Idan an kunna, duk ɓangarorin harshe ɗaya da aka nufa sun kammala kafin harshe na gaba ya fara. Yana da amfani don kallo ci gaba a ainihin lokaci.
step2.nameDetectionDesc: Yana ba da damar Tsarin Suna don gano kafofin watsa labarai ta atomatik daga sunayen fayil yayin lodawa da binciken ɗakin karatu.
step2.tmdbIntegrationDesc: Yana haɗa zuwa TheMovieDB API don kawo bayanan kafofin watsa labarai, nau'ukan, da shekarun sakin kafofin watsa labarai da aka daidaita. Yana buƙatar maɓallin API.
step2.showPostersDesc: Nuna fasahar kafofin watsa labarai a cikin jerin taken ƙasa da ra'ayoyin ɗakin karatu. Yana buƙatar TheMovieDB da aka saita.
step2.libraryScanningDesc: Yana bincike ta atomatik a cikin hanyoyin ɗakin karatu da aka saita don fayilolin bidiyo da taken ƙasa akan jadawali, yana ƙirƙirar ayyukan fassara kamar yadda ake buƙata.
step2.autoClearLogsDesc: Yana goge shigarwar rikodin tsufa fiye da adadin kwanaki da aka saita don kiyaye tebur na riko mai sauƙi.
step2.defaultTargetLangs: Yarurrukan Da Aka Nufa na Tsoho
step2.defaultTargetLangsDesc: Jerin yarurrukan da aka tsara wanda taken ƙasa ke fassara zuwa ta tsoho. An zaɓa kafin ga kowane mai amfani lokacin da suka loda fayil ɗin taken ƙasa ko kuma suka kunna fassarar ɗakin karatu.
step2.perUserLangsDesc: Kowane mai amfani na iya maye gurbin tsoffin tsarin tare da jerin yare nasu ta hanyar saitin Asusunsu. Sabbin masu amfani suna farawa tare da tsoffin tsarin. Za ka saita tsoffin tsarin a mataki na gaba.

step3.title: Yarurrukan Fassara na Tsoho
step3.subtitle: Zaɓi aƙalla yare ɗaya don fassara taken ƙasa zuwa ta tsoho. Waɗannan suna zama tsoffin duk tsarin ga duk masu amfani.
step3.empty: Ba a ƙara yarurruka tukuna. Yi amfani da mai zaɓi a ƙasa.

step4.title: Shigar da Samfuri
step4.subtitle: Shigar da aƙalla samfuri ɗaya. Ana ba da matsayi (Fassara, Mai Shari'a, Tsarin Suna) a mataki na gaba.
